+from rich.cells import cell_len
+
+def test_zwj():
+    # Case 1: ZWJ at the end of the string
+    # Before fix, this raised StopIteration
+    try:
+        width = cell_len("A\u200d")
+        print(f"cell_len('A\\u200d') = {width}")
+        assert width == 1
+    except StopIteration:
+        print("FAILED: cell_len('A\\u200d') raised StopIteration")
+        return False
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"FAILED: cell_len('A\\u200d') raised {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
+        return False
+
+    # Case 2: ZWJ in the middle of the string
+    # Before fix, this would skip the character after ZWJ
+    # 'A' (1) + ZWJ (0) + 'B' (1) = 2
+    # But before, it would be 'A' (1) + ZWJ (skips 'B') = 1
+    width = cell_len("A\u200dB")
+    print(f"cell_len('A\\u200dB') = {width}")
+    assert width == 2, f"Expected 2, got {width}"
+
+    # Case 3: ZWJ at the beginning
+    width = cell_len("\u200dA")
+    print(f"cell_len('\\u200dA') = {width}")
+    assert width == 1, f"Expected 1, got {width}"
+
+    # Case 4: Multiple ZWJs
+    width = cell_len("A\u200d\u200dB")
+    print(f"cell_len('A\\u200d\\u200dB') = {width}")
+    assert width == 2, f"Expected 2, got {width}"
+
+    return True
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if test_zwj():
+        print("All tests passed!")
+    else:
+        print("Some tests failed!")
+        exit(1)
